subject: Web Development
title: Voice Interfaces on the Web
description: One-minute skill: Voice Interfaces on the Web.

hook.text: The Web Speech API lets websites listen to voice commands and speak responses aloud.

buildup.text: Voice assistants like Alexa and Siri process web content to answer spoken questions.

discovery.text: Voice search changes how content should be written — conversational phrases replace keywords.

twist.text: Voice interfaces struggle with accents, noisy environments, and complex multi-step tasks.

climax.text: Voice is becoming another channel the web must support, alongside screens and keyboards.

punchline.text: The web is learning to listen, not just display.

quiz.question: What does the Web Speech API enable?
